title: The Quiet Ledger
subtitle: Bookkeeping for one-person businesses, in an hour a week
author: Your Name
description:
Most small businesses do not fail for lack of customers. They fail because nobody knows where the money went.

This book sets up a one-hour weekly routine: what to write down, where, and how to read it at the end of the month.
highlights: A simple ledger template you can copy
How to tell profit from cash in the bank
